text:
maria: kicking off an incremental activation for structured output / function-calling (so_v2) today. plan below — internal eng -> beta partners -> small public canary. tagging folks to confirm SDK and runtime guardrails :rocket:

aj: quick q — when the compat flag is OFF, do we return plain text only? when ON we return structured function_call hints? want to avoid clients breaking if they try to parse.

kevin: correct. default server behavior: compat_off -> legacy textual response; compat_on -> structured output. also runtime will have a fallback variant (model_variant=compat_off) when capacity is constrained.

sasha: adding these guardrails:
- max_function_tokens = 2000
- disable streaming for canary audiences (avoid partial parse)
- drop-in kill-switch per region
- scrubbed telemetry for sample payloads

infra-bot: deploy started: canary group "eng" -> us-west-2 (rolling 3 hosts)

deploy-bot: canary health checks: 3/3 nodes up, latency p50 stable, starting traffic ramp to 100% for "eng" audience

nina: question on exposure: will mobile SDKs that are older default to compat_off? we should add a server-side header so SDKs can opt-in safely.

oliver: +1. propose header 'X-Redwood-Compat-Version: so_v2' and server includes 'compat_hint' in response metadata. mobile older clients will ignore unknown headers.

maria: here's the rollout config I'm proposing (pseudo):
```json
{
  "flag": "structured_output_v2",
  "phases": [
    {"audience": "eng", "pct": "100"},
    {"audience": "beta-partners", "pct": "50"},
    {"audience": "public", "pct": "5"}
  ],
  "fallback_policy": "model_variant:compat_off"
}
```

aj: SDK change notes: add toggle `enable_structured_output` default false. SDK should NOT auto-parse structured payloads unless an explicit `parse_structured_output` flag is set to true by app developers. prevents accidental crashes. :eyes:

kevin: also need server-side runtime behavior: if a request has header `X-Client-Max-Compat: legacy`, prefer compat_off path even if flag on. helps partners with strict contracts.

sasha: monitoring/alarms to add before widening:
- absolute error rate increase > 0.5% => pause rollout
- malformed function_call payloads > 0.1% of so responses => rollback to previous phase
- increased token usage > 20% baseline for a route => alert billing team

maria: timeline idea: stage1 (eng) today, stage2 (beta partners) Thu, stage3 (public 5%) next Tue. will gate on the monitors above.

nina: billing note: mark requests with tag `so_v2` in usage events so finance can model cost impact.

oliver: small CR to follow: rename header suggestion to `X-Redwood-So-Compat`. sending PR now. pinging @kevin for review.

kevin: reviewing, will add integration test ensuring older SDK versions get compat_off behavior.

aj: ops ask — can we have a single-region kill switch CLI?

maria: yes. ops command: `/rollout disable structured_output_v2 --region us-west-2`

infra-bot: /rollout executed by maria at 1923456798 — disabling staged public traffic in us-west-2 (if needed)

deploy-bot: canary steady. metrics stream: 
- so_enabled_count: 2.1k
- so_error_rate: 0.02%
- so_fallback_count: 0

sasha: one more runtime note: ensure KV cache TTL is shorter for canary so we don't accidentally serve stale function signatures.

maria: telemetry events to emit: `so_enabled`, `so_error`, `so_fallback`, `so_degraded`, plus `so_parsed_success` and `so_parsed_fail` with sampling. store sample payloads to a secured bucket with PII scrubbed.

aj: will update SDK docs with compatibility matrix and example: how to opt-in safely.

oliver: CR link -> https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4217 (rename header + integration test) :thumbsup:

nina: financial tracking ticket -> FIN-2345, added `so_v2` label on the event pipeline.

maria: outstanding items:
- [ ] infra kill-switch endpoint per region (infra action)
- [ ] header final name and PR merged (oliver)
- [ ] SDK opt-in flag docs (aj)
- [ ] telemetry sampling + scrubbed payloads (privacy + infra)
- [ ] monitoring thresholds wired into rollout automation (sre)
kevin: ping on the CR, will merge after green tests.

maria: thanks all. if no blockers I'll start the beta partner ramp Thu. please @mention if you need to pause. :white_check_mark:
